neighbours.label: an approximating or scaling word right before a number in a magnitude expression (just over/under N, roughly N, of about N, 2 to the Nth power)
fire: The winning margin was just under two minutes.
The repair cost a little over ninety pounds.
The search space has 2 to the 80th power possible states.
That leaves a gap of roughly eight metres between the posts.
The flight was delayed by just over six hours.
The table can hold the factorial of about 170 before it overflows.
The two readings differ by slightly more than five percent.
Her time was just under eleven seconds in the final.
quiet: The winning margin was surprisingly narrow this year.
The repair cost more than anyone had expected.
The search space has far too many possible states to list.
That leaves a wide gap between the two posts.
The flight was delayed again because of fog.
The table can hold very large values before it overflows.
The two readings differ only in the final column.
Her time in the final was a personal best.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (1.4% of tokens reach 0.1 of max; gate-closed regime 64%), so near misses may fire weakly. Top examples: 'factor ⟦of⟧ two', 'more ⟦than⟧', 'just ⟦over⟧ five hours', '⟦2⟧ to the 128th power'. Probes 0.24-0.63 on such phrases ('factor of ten' only 0.11), 0.03-0.13 without the number.
